title: Observability standards compliance
description: All events, tasks, and spans are recorded in standard formats.
expected_behavior: StructuredLogger produces JSON logs with sensitive data redacted. MetricsCollector tracks counters, gauges, and histograms. Observability traces track latency, tokens, and cost.

test_steps.action: log a structured message with fields via StructuredLogger
test_steps.expected: JSON log with timestamp, level, message, fields

test_steps.action: record a histogram value via MetricsCollector
test_steps.expected: histogram stats (count, min, max, avg, p95) available

test_steps.action: start trace, run span, end span, retrieve trace
test_steps.expected: trace contains span with latency_ms and success status
